# opnsense_kea_dhcpv4_settings (Resource)

Kea DHCPv4 server settings (**Services ▸ Kea DHCP ▸ Kea DHCPv4 ▸ Settings**): service, interfaces, lease lifetime, lease expiry processing and HA. This is a singleton: import it with the ID `kea_dhcpv4_settings` before managing it. Attributes left unset keep their current value.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `compatibility` (Set of String) Compatibility flags: `exclude-first-last-24`, `ignore-dhcp-server-identifier`, `ignore-rai-link-selection`, `lenient-option-parsing`.
- `decline_probation_period` (Number) Seconds a declined address is held back. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `dhcp_socket_type` (String) Socket type: `raw` (needed for directly connected clients) or `udp` (relayed clients only).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable the Kea DHCPv4 server.
- `firewall_rules` (Boolean) Add the firewall rules that allow DHCP on the served interfaces.
- `flush_reclaimed_timer_wait_time` (Number) Seconds between removals of reclaimed leases. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `ha_enabled` (Boolean) Enable high availability with the peers defined in the HA peer resources.
- `ha_max_unacked_clients` (Number) Clients the partner may leave unanswered before failover. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `ha_this_server_name` (String) Name of this server among the HA peers, empty for the hostname.
- `hold_reclaimed_time` (Number) Seconds an expired lease is kept before being removed. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `interfaces` (Set of String) Interfaces to serve, e.g. `["lan"]`.
- `manual_config` (Boolean) Use a hand-written configuration file instead of the generated one.
- `max_reclaim_leases` (Number) Maximum leases reclaimed per run. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `max_reclaim_time` (Number) Maximum duration of a reclamation run, in milliseconds. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `reclaim_timer_wait_time` (Number) Seconds between lease reclamation runs. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `service_sockets_max_retries` (Number) Retries when binding a socket fails. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `service_sockets_retry_wait_time` (Number) Milliseconds between socket bind retries. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `unwarned_reclaim_cycles` (Number) Unfinished reclamation runs before a warning is logged. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `valid_lifetime` (Number) Default lease lifetime in seconds. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `kea_dhcpv4_settings`.
